name: Warrior
description:
[Warriors]<warrior> use [Attack]<attack> to deal damage with auto attacks and active abilities.

[Warrior Mechanics]<warrior>: [Crit]<crit>, [Rush]<rush>, [Shields]<shield>.
descriptionZh:
[战士]<warrior>依靠[攻击力]<attack>，通过普通攻击与主动技能造成伤害。

[战士机制：]<warrior>[暴击]<crit>、[突击]<rush>、[护盾]<shield>。

name: Tank
description:
[Tanks]<tank> use [Defense]<defense> to protect their allies and disrupt enemies.

[Tank Mechanics:]<tank> [Stall]<stall>, [Poison]<poison>, [Frost]<frost>.
descriptionZh:
[坦克]<tank>依靠[防御力]<defense>来保护盟友并干扰敌人。

[坦克机制：]<tank>[坚守]<stall>、[中毒]<poison>、[冰冻]<frost>。

name: Vanguard
description:
[Vanguards]<vanguard> use [Max HP]<maxhp> to absorb and dish out damage.

[Vanguard Mechanics:]<vanguard> [Rush]<rush>, [Shields]<shield>, [Burn]<burn>.
descriptionZh:
[先锋]<vanguard>依靠[最大生命值]<maxhp>来吸收并输出伤害。

[先锋机制：]<vanguard>[突击]<rush>、[护盾]<shield>、[燃烧]<burn>。

name: Assassin
description:
[Assassins]<assassin> use [Crit]<crit> to deal bursts of damage with their auto attacks and active abilities.

[Assassin Mechanics:]<assassin> [Crit]<crit>, [Shards]<shard>, [Poison]<poison>, [Rush]<rush>, [Stealth]<stealth>.
descriptionZh:
[刺客]<assassin>依靠[暴击]<crit>，通过普通攻击与主动技能造成爆发伤害。

[刺客机制：]<assassin>[暴击]<crit>、[碎晶]<shard>、[中毒]<poison>、[突击]<rush>、[潜行]<stealth>。

name: Duelist
description:
[Duelists]<duelist> use [Attack Speed]<attackspeed> to rapidly auto attack.

[Duelist Mechanics:]<duelist> [Stall]<stall>, [Rush]<rush>, [Debuffs]<debuff>, [Crit]<crit>, [Shards]<shard>.
descriptionZh:
[决斗者]<duelist>依靠[攻击速度]<attackspeed>进行快速的普通攻击。

[决斗者机制：]<duelist>[坚守]<stall>、[突击]<rush>、[减益效果]<debuff>、[暴击]<crit>、[碎晶]<shard>。

name: Mystic
description:
[Mystics]<mystic> use [Mana Regen]<manaregen> to repeatedly cast their active ability, aiding allies and disrupting enemies.

[Mystic Mechanics:]<mystic> [Shields]<shield>, [Shards]<shard>, [Debuffs]<debuff>, [Stall]<stall>.
descriptionZh:
[秘术师]<mystic>依靠[魔力回复]<manaregen>来反复施放主动技能，援助盟友并干扰敌人。

[秘术师机制：]<mystic>[护盾]<shield>、[碎晶]<shard>、[减益效果]<debuff>、[坚守]<stall>。

name: Mage
description:
[Mages]<mage> use [Magic]<magic> to deal damage and disrupt enemies with their active abilities.

[Mage Mechanics:]<mage> [Stall]<stall>, [Burn]<burn>, [Frost]<frost>.
descriptionZh:
[法师]<mage>依靠[法术强度]<magic>，通过主动技能造成伤害并干扰敌人。

[法师机制：]<mage>[坚守]<stall>、[燃烧]<burn>、[冰冻]<frost>。
